environment: Synthetic private workflow fixtures only; no real human labels
checks: Named reviewer pair is measured without mixing third-person gold labels or other reviewer pairs.
Three-label Cohen kappa, confusion counts and split/language coverage are computed from validated frozen reviews.
No pairs and degenerate single-class reviews cannot masquerade as perfect kappa.
The CLI reports aggregate counts only and does not change the private dataset.
limitations: A human must verify reviewer identity and independence.
A kappa result alone does not certify the gold dataset or model quality.
